scientific_scope: Predictive model governance, persistent training evidence, validation, uncertainty/calibration, explainability, applicability, benchmark evaluation and reproducibility.

methods.name: Agricultural grouped and transfer-aware validation
methods.implementation: Grouped CV, leave-one-group variants, LOYO, LORO, frozen group holdout and forward-time protocols with fold-contained preprocessing.
methods.limitations: The split label does not guarantee independence; researchers must choose grouping variables that match the deployment question.

methods.name: Out-of-fold absolute-residual interval
methods.implementation: Research Model Lab can store a 90% absolute-residual conformal-style half-width from OOF residuals for regression.
methods.limitations: This is not automatically distribution-free under arbitrary grouped/shifted deployment and must be assessed for empirical coverage.

methods.name: Model applicability profile
methods.implementation: Training-support feature ranges/categories are stored and prediction-level applicability warnings can be persisted.
methods.limitations: Range/category checks are useful OOD diagnostics but not a complete density or causal transportability model.

methods.name: Permutation importance and partial dependence
methods.implementation: Model-agnostic predictive interpretation on explicit evaluation data, with artifact-integrity verification.
methods.limitations: Importance/dependence is predictive and may be distorted by correlated features; it is not causal effect estimation.

methods.name: Model disagreement
methods.implementation: Paired held-out predictions from compatible registered models are compared on common validation rows.
methods.limitations: Disagreement is not a calibrated predictive interval. Learned ensemble weights require separate leakage-safe meta-training.

methods.name: Evidence-gated model promotion
methods.implementation: Promotion checks persistent validation scope, applicability and uncertainty/calibration metadata and records append-only status history.
methods.limitations: Operational eligibility remains a scientific governance decision; override records do not create missing empirical evidence.

methods.name: Repeated group-isolated holdout and ranking stability
methods.implementation: Group-isolated repeated holdouts with reproducible seed; fold metrics are retained and candidate median/mean rank, rank SD and fold wins can be inspected.
methods.limitations: Repeated internal holdouts are stability diagnostics, not independent external validation.

methods.name: Probability-aware classification validation
methods.implementation: Balanced accuracy, macro/weighted F1, class-specific precision/recall and, when genuine held-out probabilities exist, ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, Brier score and log loss.
methods.limitations: Probability metrics are omitted when probabilities are unavailable; probability calibration must be evaluated rather than assumed.

methods.name: Paired bootstrap model-difference diagnostic
methods.implementation: Bootstrap confidence intervals for paired delta-RMSE on common held-out records from compatible registered models.
methods.limitations: A paired bootstrap comparison does not validate stacking or create external evidence.

methods.name: Prediction-outcome chronology and drift monitoring
methods.implementation: Canonical outcome pairing respects spatial context/season where possible and exposes chronology; outcome-linked errors support transparent recent-vs-earlier monitoring.
methods.limitations: Automated matches require researcher review; an error trend is not proof of temporal drift or causation.

integrity_rules: Retain failed and inferior model attempts as training-run provenance.
Do not use test outcomes to choose ensemble weights or hyperparameters.
Do not call an internal split external validation.
Do not interpret feature importance as causal effect.
Do not silently download or redistribute large benchmark datasets.
Do not conflate prediction, recommendation, applied treatment and measured outcome.
New models enter as Prototype; registry upserts cannot silently promote evidence status.
Generic leave-one-group validation is not automatically treated as external validation.
Show prediction/observation chronology when automatically linking outcomes.
